comment: Cyberdeck physical matrix map — Micro Journal Rev 2.1 68-key PCB wired to Pi Zero 2W.
comment_source: Transcribed from stock Vial keymap layer 0 (micro-journal-rev-2.1/keyboard/keymaps/vial/keymap.c) cross-referenced with keyboard.json matrix positions.
comment_pins: BCM GPIO numbers per design.md section 4. rows[i] = matrix row i, cols[j] = matrix col j.
comment_fn: The stock MO(1) key at [7,1] emits KEY_F13; bind layer(fn) to f13 in /etc/keyd/default.conf.
comment_knobs: [7,6] = left knob push (Space), [7,7] = right knob push (Enter) — wired into the matrix by the PCB.

encoders.name: encoder1
encoders.comment: PCB pins 22/23 (stock Pico GP19/GP20). Stock action: CCW=Left, CW=Right.

encoders.name: encoder2
encoders.comment: PCB pins 24/25 (stock Pico GP21/GP22). Stock action: CCW=Up, CW=Down.
